shortDescription: Jane Foley, Rabobank's head of FX strategy, said confidence in the dollar has weakened after stronger-than-expected payrolls data, according to Bloomberg.She also said upcoming CPI data could still give the currency a boost if the reading comes in stronger than expected.

title: Rabobank's Foley Says Dollar Confidence Has Weakened
